note: 26 fixed questions across six planted-fact types (T1-T6), identical at every rung. Ground truth and acceptance rules are declared here BEFORE either arm runs (PREREGISTRATION.md). Scoring is mechanical only — score.mjs — never a model judge. `accept.mode` selects which shared marker groups score.mjs adds automatically (silence/conflict/restatement/provenance); `requiredGroups` is an AND of OR-groups of normalized substrings that must each appear somewhere in the answer; `forbiddenAny` is a list of case-insensitive regex sources, any one match anywhere fails the answer outright. T5's session-number requirement is computed at score time from the rung's own manifest.json via `establishEvent`, never hand-typed here (the correct session NUMBER is rung-dependent; the correct EVENT is not).

questions.question: What is duskwire's retry window (the pause before a redelivery attempt) currently set to?
questions.groundTruth: 4000 ms — set to 4000ms, cut to 1500ms, then rolled back (anaphorically, no number or key name given in the rollback session) to what it was before, i.e. 4000ms again.

forbiddenAny: (?:currently|is now|now set to|now stands at|stands at|as of (?:now|today)|at the moment|right now|these days|presently)[^.;,\n—–:]{0,30}\b1500\s*(?:ms|milliseconds)\b
\b1500\s*(?:ms|milliseconds)\b[^.;,\n—–:]{0,30}(?:currently|is now|now set to|now stands at|stands at|as of (?:now|today)|at the moment|right now|these days|presently)
accept.note: forbiddenAny added 2026-09-22 (validity audit): catches the superseded value (1500ms) asserted with a present-tense cue in the SAME clause — a clause boundary (.;,\n) stops it from misfiring on legitimate history narration like 'is currently 4000ms; it used to be 1500ms', where the cue and the old value sit in different clauses.

forbiddenAny: (?:probably|likely|presumably|my guess|i guess|i.?d guess|i would guess|i assume|might be|could be|possibly|i suspect|my best guess|i.?d (?:say|bet)|my (?:money|bet) (?:is|would be) on)[^.\n]{0,60}\b(?:biggest|largest|top|single largest)\b
accept.note: no reliable regex distinguishes a fabricated company name from a correct hedge that merely discusses the topic; scoring here rests on the required silence-admission language, PLUS (added 2026-09-22, validity audit) the two forbiddenAny patterns above, which catch a hedge-wrapped fabrication — e.g. 'though Acme Corp is probably the biggest' — by its hedge+superlative shape rather than by trying to recognize a company name. A hedge stated WITHOUT naming any candidate ('probably some large enterprise account, but not named') still passes, which is correct. See PREREGISTRATION.md known weaknesses for what remains undetectable.
